props.name: Scale
props.expression: amp = .05;freq = 1.0;decay = 5.0;n = 0;time_max = 4;if (numKeys > 0){n = nearestKey(time).index;if (key(n).time > time){n--;}}if (n == 0){ t = 0;}else{t = time - key(n).time;}if (n > 0 && t < time_max){v = velocityAtTime(key(n).time - thisComp.frameDuration/10);value + v*amp*Math.sin(freq*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(decay*t);}else{value}
